title: LaMDA: Language Models for Dialog Applications
authors: R. Thoppilan, D. De Freitas, J. Hall, et al. (~60 authors)
before: Large models were tuned for completion, not for holding a conversation.
problem: Dialogue needs safety, factual grounding and a consistent persona, none of which come free.
breakthrough: Dialogue-specific fine-tuning with safety and groundedness objectives, plus external tool lookups for facts.
why: Google had an aligned conversational model well before ChatGPT and chose not to ship it publicly.
next: Bard in 2023, then the Gemini line.
inherits: Safety and groundedness as explicit fine-tuning targets for chat.
